استقدموا (form X)
# اِسْتَقْدَمُوا (istaqdamū) /is.taq.da.muː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَقْدَمَ (istaqdama)
# اُسْتُقْدِمُوا (ustuqdimū) /us.tuq.di.muː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَقْدَمَ (istaqdama)
# اِسْتَقْدِمُوا (istaqdimū) /is.taq.di.muː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَقْدَمَ (istaqdama)
